data: Which method(s) achieve an accuracy of at least 95% with 25 seed examples?

The caption states that increasing the seed examples leads to better performance. The question asks which methods achieve an accuracy of at least 95% with 25 seed examples. From the analysis of the graph, we can see that the accuracy for all methods increases as the number of seed examples increases. At 25 seed examples, the accuracy for DeltaR is approximately 85%, for DeltaS is approximately 95%, for Linear is approximately 95%, for No_aug is approximately 95%, and for Upsample is approximately 95%. Therefore, the methods that achieve an accuracy of at least 95% with 25 seed examples are DeltaS, Linear, No_aug, and Upsample.
